title: Mountain Daughter
start: Talk to Hamal the Chieftain in the Mountain Camp east of Rellekka.

items.t: A plank (can be obtained during the quest)
A pole or any kind of staff (can be obtained during the quest)
A pair of leather gloves (most other gloves work too)
Five muddy rocks (can be obtained during quest around the camp)

recommended.t: Activated Fremennik Province, Taverley, Catherby and Al Kharid lodestones
Completion of The Grand Tree for access to gnome gliders

rewards.t: Access to the Mountain Camp without a rope (only requires partial completion)

steps.t: Run north of the Golden Apple Tree south-east of Rellekka (fairy ring code AJR).
Climb the cliffside to the north of the musician with a rope in your backpack.
p: A player using a rope to climb up the cliffside

steps.t: Talk to Hamal the Chieftain in the nearby village. Ask him why everyone is so hostile and continue through all the dialogue; he will then offer the quest. [Chat: 1 Why is everyone so hostile? › 1 So what are you doing up here? › Accept] (If The Fremennik Trials is completed: [Chat: 2 Why is everyone so hostile? › 1 So what are you doing up here? › Accept])
Walk south and Dig-below the Roots for a lump of Mud.
If you do not have a pole and a plank, go north of Hamal's house and pick up one of each.
Run north to the lake, then west along the edge.
Use the mud on the tall tree, climb it.
Use your staff/pole on the clump of rocks.
p: Climbing the tall tree to gain access to the island

steps.t: Use your plank on the flat stone.

Stand next to the pile of rocks and listen to one of the shining pools. [Chat: 2 Hello! Who are you! › 2 So what exactly do you want from me? › 1 That sounds like something I can do. › 1 I'll get right on it.]
Use your plank on the flat stone again. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Hamal the Chieftain. [Chat: 2 About the people of Rellekka... › 1 Why do you hate them so much?]
Talk to Jokul in the goat farm to the north.
Talk to Svidi wandering near the Fremennik lodestone. [Chat: 2 Can't I persuade you to go in there somehow?]

Go to the longhall in Rellekka, talk to Brundt the Chieftain about the Mountain Camp. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Mountain Camp. › Any] (If Lunar Diplomacy has been started or completed: [Chat: 2 Ask about the Mountain Camp. › Any])
Mine the ancient rock in the mountain camp's southern tent.
Return to Brundt the Chieftain in the longhall. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Mountain Camp.] (If Lunar Diplomacy has been started or completed: [Chat: 2 Ask about the Mountain Camp.])
Give the safety guarantee to Svidi.
Make your way to White Wolf Mountain.

sub.t: If you have completed The Grand Tree, teleport to Al Kharid lodestone, run north-west and click on "Glider Captain Dalbur" [Chat: 2 Sindarpos.]

p: A thorny bush, just south of the gnome glider on the peak of White Wolf Mountain

steps.t: Wearing leather gloves (or gauntlets), pick from the bush next to the gnome glider.
Eat the fruit.
Return to Hamal the Chieftain in the Mountain Camp. [Chat: 3 About your food supplies... › 2 About the people of Rellekka...]
Go to the centre of the lake and stand next to the pile of rocks.
Listen-to the shining pool again.
Jump-across the flat stone, falling into the water, and run east along the northern shore.
Chop down some of the small trees.
Enter the cave.

If you've not fully completed both tasks in the section above and gone through the dialogue completely, you'll receive a message referring to a stench that prevents you from entering the cave. Repeat the tasks until you're allowed to enter the cave.
Talk to the Kendal. [Chat: 1 It's just me, no one special. › 2 You mean sacrifice? › 3 You look like a man in a bearsuit! › 2 Can I see that corpse? › 1 Hand the body over to me!]
p: You can find a safe spot around the skeletons to attack Kendal with Ranged or Magic.

steps.t: Kill the Kendal.
Take the corpse of woman next to all the skeletons.
Return to Hamal the Chieftain. [Chat: 2 But he killed your daughter! › 1 I will.]
Take 5 muddy rocks from the camp. They can be found around the mud pond and in the goat pen north of the tent.
Talk to Ragnar by the lake for Asleif's necklace. [Chat: 1 Thank you. I will make sure she's given a proper burial now.]
Bury the corpse in the centre of the lake.
Use the rocks on the burial mound.
Quest complete!
